hints.tr: Önce kodla, sonra vurgula: vurgu etiketleri bizim, kodlanmamalı.
hints.en: Encode first, then highlight: the highlight tags are ours and must not be encoded.

hints.tr: Kelime de kodlanır; yoksa `<` gibi bir kelime kodlanmış metinde bulunamaz.
hints.en: The word is encoded too; otherwise a word like `<` cannot be found in the encoded text.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
import html


def highlight(text, word):
    safe_text = html.escape(text)
    if not word:
        return safe_text
    safe_word = html.escape(word)
    return safe_text.replace(safe_word, f"<mark>{safe_word}</mark>")

print(highlight("x<y", "y"))
print(highlight("tea & tee", "te"))
print(highlight("a<b", "<"))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
import html


def highlight(text, word):
    safe_text = html.escape(text)
    if not word:
        return safe_text
    safe_word = html.escape(word)
    return safe_text.replace(safe_word, f"<mark>{safe_word}</mark>")

print(highlight("x<y", "y"))
print(highlight("tea & tee", "te"))
print(highlight("a<b", "<"))
```
